angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,191,038 km at 356.15 pc = 0.04 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 2.8078 +/- 0.0158 mas (same row, RUWE 1.02): 356.15 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.712 +/- 0.083 solar radii from Barkaoui et al. 2019, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of WASP-161 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....157...43B/abstract): 1,191,038 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.39 +/- 0.14 solar masses from Barkaoui et al. 2019, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of WASP-161 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....157...43B/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6400 +/- 100 K from Barkaoui et al. 2019, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-161 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....157...43B/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Barkaoui et al. 2019, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of WASP-161 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....157...43B/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/wasp-161.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.114, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-161 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.16 dex, from Barkaoui et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....157...43B/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-161 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.64738, from Barkaoui et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....157...43B/abstract)
ageSource: Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 5751177095877066496, flags_flame 00: age_flame 3.0796 Gyr (16th to 84th percentiles 2.6300278 to 3.5290952)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of WASP-161 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 18 km/s, from Barkaoui et al. 2019 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2019AJ....157...43B/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
